about: Every error task game:mods finds in the corpus mods, classified: a real defect of the mod (real-defect), shown from the mod and game 1.21.0.3 with the reason; a fault of the committed spec package (spec-package-fault); a fault of pychivalry to fix (pychivalry-fault, which fails the suite); or not shown either way (unclassified, which fails the suite too). An entry covers the errors of its code in its mod and file at each of its lines; an error with no entry, and an entry line that matches no error, fail the suite (tools/src/check-suite.ts). Game 1.21.0.3, spec package 1.21.0.3 format 8, the pinned corpus of records/corpus/MANIFEST.tsv.
